quests.instruction: You believe you will do better on your next spelling test after missing a few words. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Believing you will improve next time, even after a setback, feels bright and hopeful.
quests.explanation: Believing you will improve next time, even after a setback, gives you a bright, hopeful outlook.
quests.funFact: Believing you can improve is one of the biggest keys to actually getting better at something!

quests.instruction: Someone keeps tapping their pencil right next to you during quiet reading time. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A small, repeated noise breaking your concentration can make you want to sigh.
quests.explanation: A small, repeated noise breaking your concentration can give you a mildly annoyed feeling.
quests.funFact: Asking quietly and kindly is usually the fastest way to solve a small noise distraction.

quests.instruction: Your grandma tells you she is staying for an extra whole week. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Hearing that time with someone you love just got longer can bring a big, bright smile.
quests.explanation: Hearing that time with someone you love just got longer fills you with a bright, joyful feeling.
quests.funFact: Extra time with people we love is one of the simplest, most joyful gifts of all!

quests.instruction: You beg your parents to leave for the trip a little earlier than planned. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Wanting to get moving toward something fun sooner than planned feels ready and bouncy.
quests.explanation: Wanting to get moving toward something fun sooner than planned fills you with ready energy.
quests.funFact: This ready-to-go feeling is one reason the night before a trip can feel hard to wait through!

quests.instruction: You sit by a crackling fire on a quiet, snowy evening. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A warm, quiet spot with a gentle, steady sound nearby feels deeply calm.
quests.explanation: A warm, quiet spot with a gentle, crackling sound nearby gives you a deeply calm feeling.
quests.funFact: The soft crackle of a fire is a sound that has helped people feel calm and safe for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: You believe your broken toy can be fixed, even though it looks pretty bad. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Believing something can still be made right, even when it looks difficult, feels bright and hopeful.
quests.explanation: Believing something can still be made right, even when it looks difficult, gives you a bright, hopeful outlook.
quests.funFact: Many broken toys can be fixed with a little glue, tape, or a helper's steady hands!

quests.instruction: The video keeps buffering right at the best part of the show. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Getting interrupted at the exact wrong moment can make you sigh with annoyance.
quests.explanation: Getting interrupted at the exact wrong moment can give you a mildly annoyed feeling.
quests.funFact: A stronger internet connection can often help stop this kind of interruption from happening!

quests.instruction: You find out the class trip is somewhere you have always wanted to go. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Hearing your dream destination is finally happening can bring a big, bright smile.
quests.explanation: Hearing your dream destination is finally happening fills you with a bright, joyful feeling.
quests.funFact: Anticipating a dream trip is part of what makes the whole experience feel extra joyful!

quests.instruction: You line up first for the field trip bus, ready to go. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Wanting to be first to start an adventure can make you hurry to the front.
quests.explanation: Wanting to be first to start an adventure fills you with ready, bouncy energy.
quests.funFact: Being early for something fun is a common sign of this ready, excited feeling!

quests.instruction: You sit by a still lake with nothing but birdsong around you. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Being surrounded by quiet, gentle sounds in nature can feel deeply calm.
quests.explanation: Being surrounded by quiet, gentle sounds in nature gives you a deeply calm feeling.
quests.funFact: Still water and birdsong are two of nature's most calming, gentle sounds!

quests.instruction: You believe the garden will grow beautifully, even though it is just starting out. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Believing something small now will become something wonderful feels bright and hopeful.
quests.explanation: Believing something small now will grow into something wonderful gives you a bright, hopeful outlook.
quests.funFact: Gardeners often say believing in a slow-growing plant is part of what makes gardening so rewarding!

quests.instruction: Your pencil keeps breaking every time you try to sharpen it. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A small task going wrong again and again can make you sigh with annoyance.
quests.explanation: A small task going wrong again and again can give you a mildly annoyed feeling.
quests.funFact: Turning the sharpener slowly and gently can often help stop pencil lead from breaking!

quests.instruction: You bite into a strawberry that tastes even sweeter than you expected. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Tasting something even better than you hoped can bring a big, bright smile.
quests.explanation: Tasting something even better than you hoped fills you with a bright, joyful little burst of feeling.
quests.funFact: Strawberries taste sweetest when they are picked at the perfect moment of ripeness!

quests.instruction: You ask to read the next chapter even though class is about to end. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Not wanting to stop something you are enjoying feels ready and bouncy.
quests.explanation: Not wanting to stop something you are enjoying fills you with ready, wanting-more energy.
quests.funFact: Getting lost in a good book is one of the clearest signs of this excited, ready feeling!

quests.instruction: You listen to soft rain tapping gently on the roof as you fall asleep. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A gentle, steady sound as you drift off to sleep can feel deeply calm.
quests.explanation: A gentle, steady sound as you drift off to sleep gives you a deeply calm feeling.
quests.funFact: Soft, steady sounds like gentle rain are known to help many people fall asleep more easily!

quests.instruction: You believe your team will bounce back after losing the first game of the season. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Believing a rough start does not decide the whole story feels bright and hopeful.
quests.explanation: Believing a rough start does not decide the whole story gives you a bright, hopeful outlook.
quests.funFact: Many championship teams have come back strong after losing their very first game of the season!

quests.instruction: Your shoe keeps untying every few steps on your walk to school. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A small problem that keeps happening again and again can make you sigh in annoyance.
quests.explanation: A small problem that keeps happening again and again can give you a mildly annoyed feeling.
quests.funFact: Double-knotting your laces is a quick trick that can stop this exact problem!

quests.instruction: Your puppy greets you at the door with its whole body wagging. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Being greeted with pure joy the moment you walk in can bring a big, bright smile.
quests.explanation: Being greeted with pure joy the moment you walk in fills you with a bright, joyful feeling.
quests.funFact: A dog's whole-body wag is one of the clearest signs of pure joy in the animal world!

quests.instruction: You show up early to soccer practice, excited to get started. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Arriving before you need to because you cannot wait to begin feels ready and bouncy.
quests.explanation: Arriving early because you cannot wait to begin fills you with ready, bouncy energy.
quests.funFact: Warming up early is also a smart way to get your body ready for the game ahead!

quests.instruction: You sit on the beach at sunset as the waves move gently in and out. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching a slow, steady, gentle rhythm in nature can feel deeply calm.
quests.explanation: Watching a slow, steady, gentle rhythm in nature gives you a deeply calm feeling.
quests.funFact: The steady rhythm of ocean waves is one of the most universally calming sounds in nature!

quests.instruction: You believe you will make new friends at your new school, even before the first day. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Believing good things are ahead in a new situation feels bright and hopeful.
quests.explanation: Believing good things are ahead in a new situation gives you a bright, hopeful outlook.
quests.funFact: Kids who expect to make friends often end up smiling more, which genuinely helps them make friends!

quests.instruction: A tag in your shirt keeps scratching the back of your neck. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A small, constant discomfort that will not go away can make you want to fidget.
quests.explanation: A small, constant discomfort that will not go away can give you a mildly annoyed feeling.
quests.funFact: Many clothes now come with tagless labels printed right onto the fabric to solve this exact problem!

quests.instruction: Your teacher reads your story out loud because she loved it so much. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Having your own work celebrated in front of the class can bring a big, bright smile.
quests.explanation: Having your own work celebrated in front of the class fills you with a bright, joyful feeling.
quests.funFact: Hearing your own words read aloud is a wonderful way to feel proud of your writing!

quests.instruction: You keep asking your art teacher if you can start the new project today. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Wanting to jump straight into a new creative project feels ready and bouncy.
quests.explanation: Wanting to jump straight into a new creative project fills you with ready, bouncy energy.
quests.funFact: This ready feeling often sparks some of the most creative and energetic art projects!

quests.instruction: You watch the sunrise quietly from your window with a warm drink. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A quiet, slow moment watching the world wake up gently can feel deeply calm.
quests.explanation: A quiet, slow moment watching the world wake up gently gives you a deeply calm feeling.
quests.funFact: Watching a sunrise slowly change color is a favorite calming ritual for people all over the world!

quests.instruction: You start your new school year believing it will be a great one. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Believing good things are ahead, even before you know for sure, feels bright and hopeful.
quests.explanation: Believing good things are ahead, even before you know for sure, gives you a bright, hopeful outlook.
quests.funFact: Starting something new with a bright outlook often helps it turn out even better!

quests.instruction: Your headphones keep slipping out of your ears during your favorite song. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A small annoyance interrupting something you are enjoying can make you sigh.
quests.explanation: A small annoyance interrupting something you are enjoying can give you a mildly annoyed feeling.
quests.funFact: Different ear tip sizes can often help headphones fit more snugly and stop slipping!

quests.instruction: You take the very first bite of a cake made just the way you love it. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Tasting something made exactly the way you love can bring a big, bright smile.
quests.explanation: Tasting something made exactly the way you love fills you with a bright, joyful feeling.
quests.funFact: Foods made with a favorite recipe often bring back warm memories along with great taste!

quests.instruction: You are first in line the moment the library doors open. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Rushing to be first for something you enjoy feels ready and bouncy.
quests.explanation: Rushing to be first for something you enjoy fills you with ready, bouncy energy.
quests.funFact: Being first in line for the library often means first pick of the newest books!

quests.instruction: You watch fish glide slowly and silently around a garden pond. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching slow, silent movement in a quiet garden feels deeply calm.
quests.explanation: Watching slow, silent movement in a quiet garden gives you a deeply calm feeling.
quests.funFact: Watching fish swim slowly is such a calming activity that many waiting rooms use it on purpose!
